task.title: Fix workspace websocket missing events (messages, reactions, threads, DMs)

events.content: Use executionCtx.waitUntil for websocket fanout and queue sends on message/thread/reaction/DM writes: Use executionCtx.waitUntil for websocket fanout and queue sends on message/thread/reaction/DM writes

raw.question: Use executionCtx.waitUntil for websocket fanout and queue sends on message/thread/reaction/DM writes
raw.chosen: Use executionCtx.waitUntil for websocket fanout and queue sends on message/thread/reaction/DM writes
raw.reasoning: Cloudflare may terminate unresolved fire-and-forget promises at response end, causing dropped realtime events; waitUntil makes delivery lifecycle explicit and reliable

retrospective.summary: Made realtime event fanout reliable by running message/thread/reaction/DM fanout and webhook queue sends in request background lifecycle (waitUntil), fixing dropped workspace-stream events.
